features.subheading: We built FixOnRoad to solve every pain-point local mechanics face daily.

items.title: No Wasted Trips
items.desc: Get accurate GPS pins. You only travel when you accept a job near you. See distance and ETA before accepting.

items.title: Fixed Pricing, No Haggling
items.desc: Customers accept the price before booking. No bargaining at the roadside. Your rate = your earnings.

items.title: Instant Secure Payouts
items.desc: Instant daily settlements directly via UPI (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm) or direct bank transfer. Zero hold time.

items.title: Zero Commission (Launch)
items.desc: Keep 100% of every rupee during our launch phase. No hidden fees. No platform deductions.

items.title: Build Your Reputation
items.desc: Every 5-star review builds your profile. Top mechanics get priority in job dispatch.

items.title: Grow Your Business
items.desc: Track your earnings, completion rate, and customer feedback in a simple dashboard.

items.title: Sign Up Free
items.desc: Register with your phone number. Choose your focus: Two-Wheeler Specialist, Car & EV Specialist, or Multi-Vehicle Technician. Upload Aadhaar/PAN for verification. Takes 2 minutes.

items.title: Go Online
items.desc: Toggle your status to "Online" when ready. You'll receive jobs within your radius.

items.title: Fix & Earn
items.desc: Accept a job, ride to the pin, fix the vehicle (bike or car), get paid. It's that simple.

items.text: I earn ₹3,000 extra every week without leaving my garage area.
items.name: Sanjay Das

items.text: The fixed pricing means customers never argue. I just do my work.
items.name: Pradeep Mondal

items.text: Instant payouts changed my life. No more waiting for cash.
items.name: Bikash Roy

items.q: Do I need an existing garage or physical shop?
items.a: No, both independent mobile mechanics and established garage owners can sign up.

items.q: What documents are required for onboarding?
items.a: Valid Aadhaar card, PAN card, and a bank account/UPI ID for instant payouts.

items.q: How and when do I get paid?
items.a: Payouts are instant per job completion via UPI or settled daily to your bank account.

items.q: How do commissions work after the 6-month launch period?
items.a: Zero commission for your first 6 months. Afterward, a nominal flat convenience fee per job is charged—no hidden cuts.

cta.desc: Join 500+ mechanics already earning with FixOnRoad. Registration is free and takes 2 minutes.
